answer: Ephemeral Reputation Decay Ledger: each identity accrues score only through verified peer interactions, decaying to a whisper at the nadir after 30 days without activity. Cloning costs an attacker the full onboarding compute plus a 72-hour warm-up before any score counts, while honest agents retain continuity for free. A fake cluster never reaches usable reputation because its low-score state in the meadow of active peers is visible and unrewarded.
